original_bug_mechanism: Resource-initiated blockwise responses advertise the maximum size instead of the smaller resource-selected size.
synthetic_bug_mechanism: A 32-bit continuation offset is narrowed before its range check. Offset 65552 wraps to 16 and incorrectly selects a tiny block size.
distinctness: The original upstream fix is retained. A 32-bit continuation offset is narrowed before its range check. Offset 65552 wraps to 16 and incorrectly selects a tiny block size.
oracle: Resource offset 65552 exceeds the maximum block size and must keep the maximum-size advertisement; its low 16 bits must not determine negotiation.
realism: Comparing after narrowing to the destination field type is a realistic integer-range mistake.
test_changes: Minimal additions to the existing regression suite; original tests and assertions preserved.
